requirements.why: keeps the daemon's one shared address open across every daemon, so a call made during a handover queues for the daemon that accepts next instead of being refused (docs/investigations/2026-11-18-stable-sockets-design.md)
requirements.label: com.agentrepl.sockethold.daemon

requirements.why: builds the Go systems (daemon, store, sidecar, shim-lock); Emacs cold start and every deploy run bin/build-frontend.sh
persistent-wifi mode runs each pmset change as `sudo -n`: the sleep lines turn the mode on and off, and the powermode lines move the energy mode with the lid and the power source

the daemon follows pull requests and GitHub merge queues, and posts pull-request comments, through the user's own gh login (internal/ghclient); without it those verbs answer GitHub unreachable and nothing else is affected

the daemon follows and posts in Slack threads, and runs the Slack reaction initiator, through the user's own gns command line (internal/gnsclient); without it those verbs answer unreachable and nothing else is affected

install.manual: Install the GNS command line, then sign in with `gns auth login` (the /gns-auth-renew skill signs in through the work account's Chrome profile).
